verdict.rationale: Vercel offers event-driven notifications rather than condition-based alerting. The Slack marketplace integration sends chat messages for comments, deployment status and new projects. Webhooks POST deployment events, including Deployment Error and Rollback, which you could route to chat or email yourself. Observability monitors traffic, function performance and errors, but no evidence shows alert rules or thresholds built on that data. Missing for 10: native configurable alert rules on metrics or error conditions, email notification channel, independent or hands-on corroboration.
